trip.description: Eight nights on Kauaʻi with three people who enjoy different things for different reasons. The plan is structured enough to make good experiences happen, and loose enough to let the island win.

family.Connie: Adventurous geocaching, beautiful landscapes, snorkeling, and at least one genuine family core memory. Wants a framework, not a minute-by-minute leash.
family.Mom: Relaxation first. Loves experiences, water, good food, scenic drives, a luau, and time at the resort.
family.Brandon: Freedom is intentional. He can join the shared plan or peel off for his own interests, then reconnect with the family later.

days.title: Arrival · settle in
days.description: Līhuʻe Airport → Turo pickup → initial groceries → Waipouli headquarters. Unpack, explore the resort and settle into island time.

activities.title: Arrive in Līhuʻe
activities.detail: Keep the first afternoon intentionally light.

activities.title: Turo pickup + Target
activities.detail: Pick up the vehicle and do the initial grocery haul near the airport.

activities.title: Waipouli Beach Resort
activities.detail: Check in, unpack, explore the resort and immediate surroundings.

activities.title: Easy dinner
activities.detail: No major commitment. Let the trip begin without a schedule.

family.Mom: Low-pressure arrival day; do not add a major activity.
family.Connie: Settle in and orient yourself without immediately optimizing the whole island.

days.flex: If travel runs late, skip exploration and go straight to headquarters. Safeway across the street can handle later grocery top-ups.

days.title: Kapaʻa + Keālia coast
days.description: Use Kapaʻa as the cultural and immersive anchor, with Keālia Beach as the beach anchor. Snorkeling is the weather/ocean-dependent cherry on top.

activities.title: Kapaʻa wandering
activities.detail: Local food, shops, markets, coastline, and character. No rigid timed excursion.

activities.title: Eat somewhere that feels local
activities.detail: Leave enough time to stop, browse, and choose rather than chase a reservation.

activities.title: Keālia Beach
activities.detail: Beach time and coastline. Snorkeling only if conditions cooperate.

activities.title: Sunset / easy dinner
activities.detail: Keep the evening open.

family.Mom: Relaxation and local atmosphere without an early alarm.
family.Connie: Explore Kapaʻa and see where the day leads.
family.Brandon: Freedom to wander or join the family.

days.flex: Poor snorkeling does not break the day. Poor beach weather shifts emphasis to Kapaʻa and other sheltered options.

days.title: Scenic drive · waterfall day
days.description: Scenic drive + Da Life Outdoors waterfall adventure. The Saturday Oct 24 tour is booked for the 11:00 AM start, with Wailua Falls as the scenic lead-in.

activities.title: Wailua Falls
activities.detail: Scenic stop before the guided waterfall experience.

activities.title: Bamboo Falls + Papakolea Falls
activities.detail: Private-property waterfall swim/hike. Saturday Oct 24 at 11:00 AM is booked.

activities.title: Return toward Kapaʻa
activities.detail: Leave breathing room. Do not automatically stack another major activity.

family.Mom: Committed to the Saturday waterfall day; keep the rest of the afternoon spacious.
family.Connie: Great landscape + adventure day without turning it into an endurance event.
family.Brandon: Can join or use the flexible space.

reservation.name: Waterfall Swim & Hike — Da Life Outdoors

days.flex: If weather or operator conditions disrupt the tour, follow the operator's guidance and keep the afternoon flexible.

days.title: Connie’s dedicated geocaching day
days.description: Connie gets the dedicated geocaching expedition. Brandon may join. Mom may join or default to beach + cocktail time. The geocaching route remains a separate planning thread.

activities.title: Geocaching expedition
activities.detail: Use Geocaching.com for the actual cache route. Let the caches take Connie somewhere she otherwise might not have gone.

activities.title: Mom’s resort day
activities.detail: Beach, pool, cocktail, book, or whatever relaxation sounds good.

activities.title: Reunite
activities.detail: Shared dinner or sunset. Different paths, same place.

family.Mom: Default plan is beach + cocktail time if she does not join.
family.Connie: Adventure day. Do not over-plan the cache route inside the vacation dashboard.
family.Brandon: No pre-planned alternative is necessary; freedom is intentional.

days.flex: If weather or access disrupts the cache plan, turn it into a flexible exploration/beach day rather than forcing the objective.

days.title: Waimea Canyon
days.description: Primary plan if access is restored: Waimea Canyon plus appropriate west-side viewpoints/trails. Keep the detailed route intentionally open until access is known.

activities.title: Head west
activities.detail: Make Waimea Canyon the dedicated landscape day.

activities.title: Waimea Canyon viewpoints
activities.detail: Exact route and hiking stops deferred until access conditions are known.

activities.title: Kōkeʻe / west side
activities.detail: Conditional on current road and park access.

family.Mom: Review the primary concept before a detailed backup route is built.
family.Connie: This is the big landscape day; prioritize scenery over checking boxes.
family.Brandon: Join the scenic day or enjoy a lighter alternative if desired.

days.flex: West/south scenic-drive backup if Kōkeʻe Road or relevant west-side access remains closed. Do not improvise around closures.

days.title: Capt Andy’s BBQ + snorkel · Nāpali Coast
days.description: Capt Andy’s Star Snorkel BBQ Sail is now the family’s selected Day 6 ocean excursion. The afternoon stays intentionally open after the boat.

activities.title: Capt Andy’s check-in
activities.detail: Confirmed family plan: 5.5-hour Star Snorkel BBQ Sail with snorkeling, breakfast, and BBQ lunch.

activities.title: Back on land
activities.detail: The rest of the day stays deliberately unscheduled.

activities.title: Easy dinner
activities.detail: No second major activity.

family.Mom: Capt Andy’s is the selected boat day. Relax and enjoy the snorkeling, scenery, and BBQ without adding another major activity afterward.
family.Connie: Ocean + landscape day with room to enjoy it.
family.Brandon: Optional joiner; the afternoon remains open.

reservation.name: Capt Andy’s Star Snorkel BBQ Sail
reservation.detail: Charge alert confirms the Capt Andy’s Sailing reservation.

days.flex: If ocean conditions are unsafe, accept the operator’s cancellation/reschedule decision and use a low-key backup rather than scrambling.

days.title: Zipline · luau
days.description: Active afternoon lead-in followed by the shared evening anchor: Kōloa Zipline from 11:45 AM–2:00 PM, then straight into getting ready for Smith Family Garden Luau at 5:00 PM.

activities.title: Arrive for Kōloa Zipline
activities.detail: Arrive 30 minutes before the 11:45 AM tour start.

activities.title: Kōloa Zipline
activities.detail: Reduced 4-line tour. Reservation confirmed.

activities.title: Open afternoon
activities.detail: Family plan: finish ziplining, then go straight into getting cleaned up, changed, and ready for the 5:00 PM luau. The three-hour window is intentionally the reset period.

activities.title: Smith Family Garden Luau
activities.detail: October schedule starts at 5:00 PM. Arrive with time to enter the gardens before the 6:00 PM imu ceremony.

activities.title: Family evening
activities.detail: Let the luau be the shared memory; no afterparty itinerary required.

family.Mom: This should feel like permission to relax until the luau.
family.Connie: Enjoy the cultural experience without turning it into research homework.
family.Brandon: Easy day; join the family anchor.

reservation.name: Kōloa Zipline + Smith Family Garden Luau
reservation.detail: Both Day 7 reservations are booked: 11:45 AM–2:00 PM Kōloa Zipline, followed by the 5:00 PM luau.

days.flex: If the luau is unavailable, preserve the slow day and substitute a relaxed local dinner + sunset/family evening.

days.title: Island time + Tidepools
days.description: Sleep in, beach/pool, revisit a favorite place, or let the family choose spontaneously. Evening anchor is a booked special family dinner at Tidepools.

activities.title: Choose-your-own island time
activities.detail: No required activity. Revisit a favorite place or stay at the resort.

activities.title: Tidepools
activities.detail: Booked family dinner at the Grand Hyatt Kauai for 7:00 PM.

activities.title: Optional sunset
activities.detail: Līhuʻe sunset is approximately 6:02 PM on Oct 29; enjoy sunset beforehand if the family wants it, then head to the 7:00 PM dinner.

family.Mom: Leave the daytime relaxed and protect the 7:00 PM Tidepools dinner as the shared evening anchor.
family.Connie: Keep the daytime loose and make the special dinner the final-full-day memory anchor.
family.Brandon: Flexible daytime; Tidepools is the family reunion point.

reservation.name: Tidepools at Grand Hyatt Kauai
reservation.detail: OpenTable confirmation verifies a table for 3 on Thursday Oct 29 at 7:00 PM.

days.flex: If the reservation changes, choose another special family dinner closer to headquarters and keep the day relaxed.

days.title: Departure · pressure release
days.description: Checkout at 11:00 AM, stay relatively close to Līhuʻe/airport, eat, take a final swim or nearby stop, return the rental car, and fly home.

activities.title: Checkout
activities.detail: Leave Waipouli and keep the remaining day geographically simple.

activities.title: Final island time
activities.detail: Slow breakfast, final swim or nearby activity, lunch. No ambitious cross-island mission.

activities.title: Turo return
activities.detail: Exact car-return timing still needs confirmation.

activities.title: Flight home
activities.detail: Build generous airport margin rather than squeezing in one last attraction.

family.Mom: No detailed planning needed yet; first confirm Turo return timing.
family.Connie: Pressure-release day. The vacation does not need one final boss battle.
family.Brandon: Keep the last day easy and flexible.

days.flex: A cancelled earlier activity can spill here only if it stays comfortably compatible with checkout, car return, and airport timing.
